data.name: Sabiqah
data.gender_notes: Sabiqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sabiqah is derived from the Arabic word 'sabqa', which means to precede or to be a pioneer. It is a unisex name that is used for both boys and girls in the Muslim community. The name Sabiqah carries the meaning “Preceding, Pioneer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Sabiqah usually hope their child will grow to embody preceding, pioneer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a spiritual vanguard, leading the way for others in the path of faith and devotion.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabiqah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: سبقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: السبقة: هي الطاعة والقبول عند أول الأمر، وسبق الأولون في الإسلام، وأول من أهلها الفاطمة الزهراء، ومنها أسماؤها التي تليها أسماء أولئك الذين سبقوا في الإسلام، وفي الحديث النبوي: "سبقت إحداكن في الإسلام، فلا ترجعوا بعدها"

in_urdu.name: سبقہ
in_urdu.meaning: معنى: سبقہ اسلام میں پہلے لوگوں میں سے ایک
in_urdu.long_meaning: سبقہ، ایک عربی نام ہے جو اسلام میں پہلے لوگوں میں سے ایک کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کے معنی ہیں "سبق" یا "پہلے لوگ"۔ یہ نام فاطمہ زہرا (علیہا السلام) کی پیدائش کے موقع پر دیا گیا تھا۔

in_hindi.name: सब़िक़ा
in_hindi.meaning: अर्थ: पहले वाले लोगों में से एक
in_hindi.long_meaning: सब़िक़ा एक अरबी नाम है जो इस्लाम में पहले लोगों में से एक के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है "पहला" या "पहले वाला"।

in_pashto.name: سبقه
in_pashto.meaning: معني: سبقہ په اسلام کې په لومړيو کې يو
in_pashto.long_meaning: سبقه په اسلام کې لومړيو کې يو په معنا يې لري چې په اسلام کې د لومړيو کسانو څخه يو وي چې په دې دين کې لوی رول لوبوه او د مسلمانانو لپاره نومول شوې.

in_english.name: Sabiqah
in_english.meaning: Meaning: Pioneering in faith and love, one of the first to follow Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Sabiqah is a name derived from the Arabic root 'Sabaq', meaning 'to precede' or 'to be first'. In Islamic tradition, it refers to the first followers of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and is often associated with the name of Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her), the daughter of the Prophet. The name is also mentioned in the Hadith, where the Prophet says, 'Those who came before you in Islam will not return after you'

data.cultural_impact: The name Sabiqah holds cultural significance in the Muslim community as it represents the value of being pioneers and leading the way in various aspects of life. This name was widely used for brave warriors who led battles and paved the way for future generations. It also represents the importance of striving for excellence and progress, as one who is the 'first' or 'pioneer' in any field or endeavor sets the bar for others to follow.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Sabiqah is significant as it encourages individuals to be proactive and take the lead in their spiritual journey. It reminds us of the importance of striving towards Allah (SWT) and seeking His pleasure in all our actions. Furthermore, being a Sabiqah means striving to understand the teachings of Islam and putting them into practice before others, thus acting as a role model for those around us. Overall, the name Sabiqah instills a sense of responsibility and determination to lead the way in both our spiritual and secular lives.
